data.one_liner: Command-line tool to remove files matching patterns from lcov.info coverage reports.
data.what_it_does: It reads an lcov.info file (or stdin) and filters out entries whose paths match given regular‑expression patterns. The filtered result is written to stdout (or a new file). This helps exclude generated or unwanted files from coverage metrics.
use_when: You need to exclude generated files (e.g., *.g.dart) from coverage reports
You work with non‑Dart projects that still produce lcov.info files
You want a quick, OS‑agnostic way to post‑process coverage data
avoid_when: Your test runner can already exclude files during generation
You need real‑time coverage filtering during test execution
strengths: Simple CLI with no extra dependencies
Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Pattern matching via RegExp provides flexible exclusions
weaknesses: Only works after the lcov.info file is generated
Limited to regex‑based file path matching
data.setup_notes: Install with `pub global activate remove_from_coverage` and run via `pub global run` or add to PATH; no native permissions required
